name: Gadelus

attributes.attribute: is another name for the hero Goidel
was the ancestor of the Goidelic Celts of Ireland, Scotland, and the Isle of Man
was said to be a grandson of an Egyptian Pharaoh healed by Moses
may correspond to Míl of the Milesians

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gadelus is another name for the Irish hero Goidel. Texts cast him as the ancestor of the Goidelic Celts of Ireland, Scotland, and the Isle of Man. One Christianized tale calls him the grandson of an Egyptian Pharaoh healed by Moses. Scholars also link him to Míl of the Milesians. See Goidel.

okr.objective: Cross-reference Gadelus to the hero Goidel.
key_results: Identify Gadelus as another name for Goidel.
